sentences.en: Translator: Joseph Geni Reviewer: Morton Bast When I was little, I thought my country was the best on the planet.
sentences.zh: 翻译人员: Cho Lena 校对人员: Honghai Lee

sentences.en: And I grew up singing a song called "Nothing To Envy."
sentences.zh: 我大一点后学会了一首叫做"无可羡慕"的歌，

sentences.en: And I was very proud. In school, we spent a lot of time studying the history of Kim Il-Sung, but we never learned much about the outside world, except that America, South Korea, Japan are the enemies.
sentences.zh: 但是我们从来没有对外面的世界有过太多了解， 除了知道美国、韩国和日本是敌人外。

sentences.en: Although I often wondered about the outside world, I thought I would spend my entire life in North Korea, until everything suddenly changed.
sentences.zh: 虽然我也时常憧憬外面的世界， 我以为我会在朝鲜度过我的一生， 直到所有事情都忽然改变。

sentences.en: When I was seven years old, I saw my first public execution.
sentences.zh: 当我七岁的时候，我第一次见证了公开处决，

sentences.en: But I thought my life in North Korea was normal.
sentences.zh: 但是我认为我在朝鲜的生活很正常。

sentences.en: My family was not poor, and myself, I had never experienced hunger.
sentences.zh: 我的家庭并不贫穷。 而且对我自己来说，我从来没有体验过饥饿的感觉。

sentences.en: But one day, in 1995, my mom brought home a letter from a coworker's sister.
sentences.zh: 但是1995年的一天，我妈妈带了一封信回家 是从她同事的姐妹那里寄来的。

sentences.en: It read, "When you read this, our five family members will not exist in this world, because we haven't eaten for the past three weeks.
sentences.zh: 上面写道，”当你读到这封信时,我家的所有五个人 都将离开人世。 因为我们已经连续两周没有吃东西了。

sentences.en: We are lying on the floor together, and our bodies are so weak, we are waiting to die."
sentences.zh: 我们现在一起躺在地板上， 我们的身体都太虚弱，准备等死。“

sentences.en: I was so shocked. This was the first time I heard that people in my country were suffering.
sentences.zh: 我当时非常震惊， 那是我第一次听到 活在我的国家的人们所在承受的一切。

sentences.en: Soon after, when I was walking past a train station, I saw something terrible that to this day I can't erase from my memory.
sentences.zh: 在这之后不久，当我走过一个火车站时， 让我难以忘怀。

sentences.en: A lifeless woman was lying on the ground, while an emaciated child in her arms just stared helplessly at his mother's face.
sentences.zh: 一个奄奄一息的女人正躺在地上， 怀里抱着一个虚弱的孩子， 那个孩子只能绝望地望着他母亲的脸。

sentences.en: But nobody helped them, because they were so focused on taking care of themselves and their families.
sentences.zh: 但是没有人帮助他们， 因为大家连自己和自己的家人都无法顾全。

sentences.en: A huge famine hit North Korea in the mid-1990s.
sentences.zh: 90年代中期朝鲜发生了一次严重的饥荒。

sentences.en: Ultimately, more than a million North Koreans died during the famine, and many only survived by eating grass, bugs and tree bark.
sentences.zh: 很不幸地，超过一百万朝鲜人 饿死在饥荒里。并且很多幸存者 是依靠吃草、虫子和树根活下来的。

sentences.en: Power outages also became more and more frequent, so everything around me was completely dark at night, except for the sea of lights in China, just across the river from my home.
sentences.zh: 停电也变得越来越频繁， 到了晚上我周围的一切都变得漆黑一片， 除了中国的灯火通明，

sentences.en: I always wondered why they had lights, but we didn't.
sentences.zh: 我经常思考为什么他们有灯火而我们没有。

sentences.en: This is a satellite picture showing North Korea at night, compared to neighbors.
sentences.zh: 这是一张卫星图，拍摄了夜晚的朝鲜 和周边国家的比较。

sentences.en: This is the Amnok River, which serves as a part of the border between North Korea and China.
sentences.zh: 这是鸭绿江， 作为着中国和朝鲜 边界的一部分。

sentences.en: As you can see, the river can be very narrow at certain points, allowing North Koreans to secretly cross.
sentences.zh: 如同你们所见，这条河在某些地方非常窄， 窄到朝鲜人能借此偷渡到中国。

sentences.en: But many die. Sometimes, I saw dead bodies floating down the river.
sentences.zh: 但是很多尝试偷渡的人死了。 有时候我看见尸体浮在水面上。

sentences.en: I can't reveal many details about how I left North Korea, but I only can say that during the ugly years of the famine, I was sent to China to live with distant relatives.
sentences.zh: 我不能披露太多我离开朝鲜时的细节， 但是我只能说那是在饥荒中最艰难的几年， 我被送到中国和远亲一起住。

sentences.en: But I only thought that I would be separated from my family for a short time.
sentences.zh: 当时我以为， 我只是和我的家人分开很短一段时间。

sentences.en: I could have never imagined that it would take 14 years to live together.
sentences.zh: 但是我从没想到， 经历了14年我们才得以重聚。

sentences.en: In China, it was hard living as a young girl without my family.
sentences.zh: 在中国，我作为一个没家的小女孩过得很辛苦。

sentences.en: I had no idea what life was going to be like as a North Korean refugee.
sentences.zh: 我根本不知道，身为一个朝鲜的难民 我未来的生活会怎样。

sentences.en: But I soon learned it's not only extremely difficult, it's also very dangerous, since North Korean refugees are considered in China as illegal migrants.
sentences.zh: 但是我很快意识到那生活不但充满了艰辛， 甚至无比危险。 因为朝鲜难民在中国

sentences.en: So I was living in constant fear that my identity could be revealed, and I would be repatriated to a horrible fate, back in North Korea.
sentences.zh: 所以我总是生活在恐惧中， 我害怕我的身份会被人发现。 我会被遣送回朝鲜，

sentences.en: One day, my worst nightmare came true, when I was caught by the Chinese police, and brought to the police station for interrogation.
sentences.zh: 有一天，我最糟糕的恶梦成真了， 我被中国警察抓住 并带去警察局接受审问。

sentences.en: Someone had accused me of being North Korean, so they tested my Chinese language abilities, and asked me tons of questions.
sentences.zh: 有人指控我是朝鲜人， 所以警察测试了我的汉语能力， 并且问了我很多问题。

sentences.en: I was so scared. I thought my heart was going to explode.
sentences.zh: 我当时非常害怕， 感觉我的心都快因恐惧而爆炸了。

sentences.en: If anything seemed unnatural, I could be imprisoned and repatriated.
sentences.zh: 如果有任何异样，我就会入狱 并被遣送回去，

sentences.en: I thought my life was over. But I managed to control all the emotions inside me, and answer the questions.
sentences.zh: 我以为我这辈子完了。 尽管如此，我还是努力隐藏了自己的恐惧和担忧， 并回答了他们的问题。

sentences.en: After they finished questioning me, one official said to another, "This was a false report. She's not North Korean."
sentences.zh: 这之后， 一个警察对另一个人说，“ 报告是错误的，

sentences.en: And they let me go. It was a miracle. Some North Koreans in China seek asylum in foreign embassies.
sentences.zh: 然后他们放我走了。真是个奇迹。 一些朝鲜人在中国

sentences.en: But many can be caught by the Chinese police, and repatriated.
sentences.zh: 但是很多人被中国警察抓住， 并被送回朝鲜。

sentences.en: These girls were so lucky. Even though they were caught, they were eventually released, after heavy international pressure.
sentences.zh: 这些女孩是幸运的， 尽管她们被抓住了， 她们最终被释放了。

sentences.en: These North Koreans were not so lucky. Every year, countless North Koreans are caught in China and repatriated to North Korea, where they can be tortured, imprisoned, or publicly executed.
sentences.zh: 但还有一些朝鲜人就没那么幸运了。 每年，无数的朝鲜人在中国被捕 回到朝鲜后，他们被折磨、关押

sentences.en: Even though I was really fortunate to get out, many other North Koreans have not been so lucky.
sentences.zh: 尽管我足够幸运能离开朝鲜， 我的好多同胞却没有这样的好运气。

sentences.en: It's tragic that North Koreans have to hide their identities and struggle so hard just to survive.
sentences.zh: 这是个很悲惨的事实，那就是朝鲜人必须要隐姓埋名， 如此努力仅仅为了能生存下去。

sentences.en: Even after learning a new language and getting a job, their whole world can be turned upside down in an instant.
sentences.zh: 即使他们学会了中文，找到了工作， 他们的整个世界也会在顷刻间颠覆。

sentences.en: That's why, after 10 years of hiding my identity, I decided to risk going to South Korea.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么，在隐姓埋名10年后， 我决定冒险去韩国。

sentences.en: And I started a new life yet again. Settling down in South Korea was a lot more challenging than I had expected.
sentences.zh: 就这样，我又一次开始了新的生活。 在韩国定居比我想象的更加困难

sentences.en: English was so important in South Korea, so I had to start learning my third language.
sentences.zh: 英语在韩国太重要了， 所以我必须要开始学习第三门语言——英语。

sentences.en: Also, I realized there was a wide gap between North and South.
sentences.zh: 此外，我意识到， 韩国与朝鲜之间有巨大的差异。

sentences.en: We are all Korean, but inside, we have become very different, due to 67 years of division.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们都是朝鲜族人， 但是我们的内在已经变得非常不同了， 由于67年的分裂。

sentences.en: I even went through an identity crisis. Am I South Korean or North Korean?
sentences.zh: 我甚至经历了自我身份的质疑。 我到底是韩国人还是朝鲜人？

sentences.en: Where am I from? Who am I? Suddenly, there was no country I could proudly call my own.
sentences.zh: 我从哪里来？我是谁？ 突然间，我似乎无法骄傲地称任何一个国家 为我自己的国家。

sentences.en: Even though adjusting to life in South Korea was not easy, I made a plan -- I started studying for the university entrance exam.
sentences.zh: 尽管适应韩国的生活并不是易事， 准备大学入学考试。

sentences.en: Just as I was starting to get used to my new life, I received a shocking phone call.
sentences.zh: 就在我刚开始习惯新生活不久， 我接到了一个令人震惊的电话。

sentences.en: The North Korean authorities intercepted some money that I sent to my family, and, as a punishment, my family was going to be forcibly removed to a desolate location in the countryside.
sentences.zh: 我寄回家的部分钱款， 作为惩罚，我的家人要被 搬到农村的一个偏僻的地方去。

sentences.en: They had to get out quickly. So I started planning how to help them escape.
sentences.zh: 他们必须要赶快逃走， 所以我开始计划帮助他们逃脱。

sentences.en: North Koreans have to travel incredible distances on the path to freedom.
sentences.zh: 朝鲜人通往自由的道路 是如此遥不可及。

sentences.en: It's almost impossible to cross the border between North Korea and South Korea.
sentences.zh: 要想穿越朝鲜与韩国 的边境几乎是不可能的，

sentences.en: So, ironically, I took a flight back to China and headed toward the North Korean border.
sentences.zh: 所以，颇具讽刺意味的是，我坐飞机到了中国 然后再前往中朝边境。

sentences.en: Since my family couldn't speak Chinese, I had to guide them somehow through more than 2,000 miles in China, and then into Southeast Asia.
sentences.zh: 因为我的家人不懂中文， 在中国穿越2000多公里， 进入东南亚。

sentences.en: The journey by bus took one week, and we were almost caught several times.
sentences.zh: 我们在巴士上的旅途有一周之久， 好几次都差点被抓住。

sentences.en: One time, our bus was stopped and boarded by a Chinese police officer.
sentences.zh: 又一次，我们坐的巴士被拦下了， 一个中国警官上了车，

sentences.en: He took everyone's I.D. cards, and he started asking them questions.
sentences.zh: 他查看每个人的身份证， 并开始问问题。

sentences.en: Since my family couldn't understand Chinese, I thought my family was going to be arrested.
sentences.zh: 因为我的家人不懂中文， 我害怕他们会被抓住。

sentences.en: As the Chinese officer approached my family, I impulsively stood up, and I told him that these are deaf and dumb people that I was chaperoning.
sentences.zh: 所以当那个中国警官快检查到我家人时， 我本能地站起来告诉他 这几位是聋哑人，

sentences.en: He looked at me suspiciously, but luckily, he believed me.
sentences.zh: 他怀疑地看着我， 但幸运地，他相信了我的话。

sentences.en: We made it all the way to the border of Laos.
sentences.zh: 就这样我们一路来到了老挝，

sentences.en: But I had to spend almost all my money to bribe the border guards in Laos.
sentences.zh: 但是我却要几乎花光全部积蓄来 贿赂老挝的边境警察。

sentences.en: But even after we got past the border, my family was arrested and jailed for illegal border crossing.
sentences.zh: 而且即使我们过了这一关， 我的家人还是因非法入境， 被捕入狱了。

sentences.en: After I paid the fine and bribe, my family was released in one month.
sentences.zh: 在我交了罚金和贿赂用的钱后， 我的家人一个月后被释放了，

sentences.en: But soon after, my family was arrested and jailed again, in the capital of Laos.
sentences.zh: 但不久后，他们在老挝的首都， 又被抓起来了。

sentences.en: This was one of the lowest points in my life.
sentences.zh: 那是我人生中最低落的时刻之一。

sentences.en: I did everything to get my family to freedom, and we came so close, but my family was thrown in jail, just a short distance from the South Korean embassy.
sentences.zh: 我为了让我的家人获得自由，倾尽所能 并且这个监狱离朝鲜大使馆并不远。

sentences.en: I went back and forth between the immigration office and the police station, desperately trying to get my family out.
sentences.zh: 我在移民局和警察局， 来来回回折腾了好多次， 绝望地努力着，希望能把他们救出来，

sentences.en: but I didn't have enough money to pay a bribe or fine anymore.
sentences.zh: 但是我已没有足够的钱 来贿赂或是交罚金了。

sentences.en: I lost all hope. At that moment, I heard one man's voice ask me, "What's wrong?"
sentences.zh: 我心灰意冷。 就在这时，我听见一个人问我， “怎么了？”

sentences.en: I was so surprised that a total stranger cared enough to ask.
sentences.zh: 我很是诧异， 一个完全的陌生人这样关切地询问。

sentences.en: In my broken English, and with a dictionary, I explained the situation, and without hesitating, the man went to the ATM, and he paid the rest of the money for my family, and two other North Koreans to get out of jail.
sentences.zh: 毫不犹豫地向那个人解释了情况。 为我的家人以及另两个朝鲜人 支付了出狱的剩余的所有费用。

sentences.en: I thanked him with all my heart, and I asked him, "Why are you helping me?"
sentences.zh: 我真心地感谢他，并问道， “你为什么要帮助我？”

sentences.en: "I'm not helping you," he said. "I'm helping the North Korean people."
sentences.zh: “我并不是在帮助你，”他回答， “我是在帮助朝鲜的人们。“

sentences.en: I realized that this was a symbolic moment in my life.
sentences.zh: 我当时就意识到那是我人生很有象征意义的一个时刻。

sentences.en: The kind stranger symbolized new hope for me and the North Korean people, when we needed it most.
sentences.zh: 那个善良的陌生人象征着我以及 朝鲜人最需要的希望。

sentences.en: And he showed me that the kindness of strangers and the support of the international community are truly the rays of hope we North Korean people need.
sentences.zh: 他使我明白，陌生人的善意 和国际社会的支持 真是我们朝鲜人需要的希望之光。

sentences.en: Eventually, after our long journey, my family and I were reunited in South Korea.
sentences.zh: 最终，在经历了漫长的旅行后， 我和家人终于在韩国重聚。

sentences.en: But getting to freedom is only half the battle.
sentences.zh: 但是获得自由只是打赢了战争的一半。

sentences.en: Many North Koreans are separated from their families, and when they arrive in a new country, they start with little or no money.
sentences.zh: 很多朝鲜人和他们的家人分离， 并且当他们来到新的国家时， 他们通常都只有很少的钱，或者身无分文。

sentences.en: So we can benefit from the international community for education, English language training, job training, and more.
sentences.zh: 所以我们可以通过国际社会的帮助 来接受教育，英语培训， 工作培训等等。

sentences.en: We can also act as a bridge between the people inside North Korea and the outside world.
sentences.zh: 我们还可以作为 世界与生活在朝鲜的同胞之间 的沟通桥梁。

sentences.en: Because many of us stay in contact with family members still inside, and we send information and money that is helping to change North Korea from inside.
sentences.zh: 因为我们很多人都和 生活在朝鲜的家人保持联系。 我们寄送回去的信息和钱 都在内在地改变朝鲜。

sentences.en: I've been so lucky, received so much help and inspiration in my life, so I want to help give aspiring North Koreans a chance to prosper with international support.
sentences.zh: 我是如此幸运， 所以我想帮助那些心怀梦想的朝鲜人 在国际的援助下，

sentences.en: I'm confident that you will see more and more North Koreans succeeding all over the world, including the TED stage.
sentences.zh: 我有信心你们将会看到越来越多的 朝鲜人在世界的舞台上取得成功， 包括TED这个舞台。

sentences.en: Thank you. (Applause)
sentences.zh: 谢谢 （掌声）
